## Quality Checklist

<!-- For new resources, confirm: -->

- [ ] **Active**: Updated within last 12 months (or content is evergreen)
- [ ] **Documented**: Has clear documentation or is well-written
- [ ] **Relevant**: Directly related to C2PA
- [ ] **Accessible**: Open source or freely accessible
- [ ] **Tested**: I've personally tested/reviewed this resource
- [ ] **Not duplicate**: Not already in the list
- [ ] **Alphabetically ordered**: Placed in correct alphabetical order within section

---

## Formatting Checklist

- [ ] Follows existing markdown formatting
- [ ] Links are properly formatted: `[Text](URL)`
- [ ] No trailing punctuation in list items
- [ ] Description is concise (1-2 sentences)
- [ ] All links work and point to correct destinations

---

## Translation Checklist (if applicable)

- [ ] Follows [translation guidelines](../CONTRIBUTING.md#translating-specifications)
- [ ] Technical terms are consistently translated
- [ ] Reviewed by at least one native speaker
- [ ] File naming follows conventions (e.g., `filename_lang-code.ext`)
- [ ] Added/updated references in README and doc/README.md
- [ ] Includes translation notes if needed
